measured_path: vLLM TT plugin serving through tt/generator_vllm.py (vllm bench serve)

after.shipped_code_note: measured with the multi-slot DSA decode buckets on; the shipped code turns them off at S >= 2 (served batch invariance, t23 / t24). Estimated +4 to +5 ms TPOT, not measured; the final scorecard run measures it. Stage 12 (ad427402ba2): per-row DSA buckets at S >= 2 (batch invariant) are opt-in only (GLM53_DSA_ROW_BUCKETS=1; default off since a6ceb44bd5b), so these numbers do not describe the shipped default; doc/decode_perf_stage12/README.md

notes: Device time is not collected on the serving path (stage-10 goal). Standalone token-out evidence: doc/optimized_vllm/README.md (t5, t14, t15b, t18).
